BIS.english: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?
BIS.capi: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?
BIS.official: Ang pinakataas nga per capita rate para sa YAKAP/Konsulta mao ang Php 1,700 sa tanang pribado ug pampublikong pasilidad. Sumala sa PhilHealth, 40% sa capitation nga kantidad i-release isip unang tranche human sa unang pag-atubang sa pasyente. Ang nabilin nga 60% i-release base sa kadako sa narehistrong catchment population hangtod Disyembre ug sa mga performance targets sa maong tuig. Base sa imong kasinatian, igo ba kini?
BIS.official_en: The maximum per capita rate amount for YAKAP/Konsulta is at Php 1,700 across private and public facilities. According to PhilHealth, 40% of the capitation amount will be released as the first tranche after the first patient encounter. The remaining 60% will be released based on the size of the registered catchment population by December and performance targets that year. Based on your practice, is this enough?
BIS.key: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?

WAR.english: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?
WAR.capi: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?
WAR.official: | December and performance targets that year. Based on your practice, is this enough? An pinakadako nga per capita rate nga kantidad para han YAKAP/Konsulta in aada ha Php 1,700 ha bug-os nga mga pribado ngan pampubliko nga mga pasilidad. Sumala han PhilHealth, 40% han kantidad nga bayad kada rehistrado nga pasyente an igpapagawas komo syahan nga bahin kahuman han syahan nga pasyente nga pagkita. An nahibibilin nga 60% in igpapagawas base han kadako han rehistrado ha populasyon nga sakop han lugar pag-abot han Disyembre ngan mga target han pagbuhat hito nga tuig. Base han iyo praktis, igo na ba ini?
WAR.official_en: The maximum per capita rate amount for YAKAP/Konsulta is at Php 1,700 across private and public facilities. According to PhilHealth, 40% of the capitation amount will be released as the first tranche after the first patient encounter. The remaining 60% will be released based on the size of the registered catchment population by December and performance targets that year. Based on your practice, is this enough?
WAR.key: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?

ILO.english: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?
ILO.capi: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?
ILO.official: Ti maximum per capita rate amount para iti YAKAP/Konsulta ket Php 1,700 iti ballasiw dagiti pribado ken publiko a pasilidad. Segun iti PhilHealth, 40% ti capitation amount ti mairuar kas umuna a tranche kalpasan ti umuna a patient encounter. Ti nabati nga 60% ket mairuar a maibatay iti kadakkel ti nairehistro a catchment population inton Disiembre ken dagiti target ti panagaramid iti dayta a tawen. Maibatay iti praktismo, umdasen kadi daytoy?
ILO.official_en: The maximum per capita rate amount for YAKAP/Konsulta is at Php 1,700 across private and public facilities. According to PhilHealth, 40% of the capitation amount will be released as the first tranche after the first patient encounter. The remaining 60% will be released based on the size of the registered catchment population by December and performance targets that year. Based on your practice, is this enough?
ILO.key: 88. The maximum per capita rate for YAKAP/Konsulta is Php 1,700 across private and public facilities (40% after first patient encounter, 60% based on registered catchment population by December). Based on your practice, is this enough?
